Emily — quick notes on the technical/ops side that procurement often asks about: 

- Invoice cadence: AWS Marketplace supports both monthly and annual settlement schedules depending on how you (the buyer) configure the contract in your AWS billing account. If Polaris needs monthly invoices, we can set the Marketplace listing to net monthly settlements for your account.
- Prepaid commitments: Marketplace supports committed spend and entitlements via AWS Contracts & Entitlements (you'll receive an entitlement ID that maps against your reserved commitment). We typically onboard the buyer to the Marketplace SKU, you make the purchase, and then provide the entitlement token to us so we can enable it on our side.
- Who submits: Buyers usually complete the purchase in AWS; Polaris can purchase and we will validate the entitlement. If you prefer, our partner ops team can initiate a guided purchase with you on a call.

Diego / Grace: suggested next steps from here — Grace to send the amendment + DocuSign link; Marcus to run a 30-min entitlements mapping call with Polaris procurement (post-sign).

- Marcus Lin
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
